CVE-DESCRIPTION: The product does not neutralize special elements used in an SQL command, allowing an attacker to inject SQL and execute arbitrary database queries.
A cross-site scripting vulnerability exists because user input is not sanitized before being written to a web page.
A buffer overflow in the parser allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted file.
The product uses a pathname constructed from user input without restricting the path to an intended directory, allowing an attacker to read arbitrary files.
The application uses a weak pseudo-random number generator to create session identifiers, making the tokens predictable.
The product does not properly validate a certificate chain, allowing an attacker to impersonate a trusted server.
An attacker can trigger an integer overflow in the length calculation, leading to a heap-based buffer overflow.
The application writes sensitive information such as passwords to a log file that is accessible to other users.
